summary: r002 BRD-050 closes all six findings from independent review r001. CX-050-01: seeds now must declare the reviewed L1_LINE_GIRDER/BUILTIN_L1 analysis and a rebuild from the submitted gene must preserve the core input hash; mismatches are rejected before solver. CX-050-02: disabled trim returns TRIM_DISABLED and unresolved NOT_CONVERGED neighbours return INCONCLUSIVE_SOLVER_FAILURES, so they cannot support CONVERGED or NO_IMPROVING_REPAIR. CX-050-03: the report materializes canonical verification_records for every solver call, including complete responses, violation messages, objectives, evaluator provenance and solver status; audit source_ref values resolve inside the report and hash the exact payload. CX-050-04: executable runtime is allowlisted to super_t_simple_v1 and super_t_parametric_v2. CX-050-05: CROSS_BEAM_DIAPHRAGM is present in the component manifest and remains fail-closed as NOT_EVALUATED at L1. CX-050-06: source_digests pin evaluator, diagnose, budget, verifier, solver, geometry, objective, state, catalogs, grammar, basis and report contract; schema closes solver status, verification records and component audit. Focused verification on current bytes passed 56/56 tests: test_design_loop 32, test_diagnose 10, test_evaluate 11 and test_optimization_budget 3. A full-suite fail-fast run collected 1911 tests and stopped at the unrelated ACTIVE BRD-053 test test_cli_adapter_parses_codex_events_with_fake_runner: expected ASSESSED but received OUT_OF_DOMAIN (21 passed, 1 failed before stop); no BRD-053 artifact was changed.
assumptions: The reviewed executable domain remains only the two Super-T grammars with L1_LINE_GIRDER and BUILTIN_L1; other families and higher fidelities require separate tasks and evidence.
The design loop is a deterministic local one-step search; CONVERGED means only that the relevant local neighbourhood was conclusively checked under the locked policy and budget.
Task-level G0 records design-basis discipline, while project site fields remain UNKNOWN and keep the project gate blocked.
unresolved_risks: SCREENED is the maximum claim. Prestress losses and stages, transfer stresses, creep-shrinkage, torsion, stability, fatigue, deck system, diaphragm resistance, L2/L3 analysis, physical tests and responsible-engineer approval remain absent.
Cost and carbon catalogs remain screening values; local convergence does not prove a global optimum and must be compared only under the same solver budget, basis, fidelity and oracle protocol.

The full repository suite currently has an unrelated BRD-053 ACTIVE-task regression in tests/test_ai_proposer.py; the 56 tests that exercise BRD-050 and its evaluator/diagnosis/budget dependencies pass on current bytes.
next_action: Independent Codex/Astra review of r002: verify all five SHA-256 hashes, rerun the 56 focused tests, adversarially probe the six closed findings, and keep the result at SCREENED; this is not engineering approval.
